title: ReleaseManifest

version.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

launcherProtocol.description: The launcher protocol the release's environment needs; a launcher that speaks a lower one refuses to install it.

databaseSchemaVersion.description: The number of the release's last database migration: a release below the database's is never a target.

bundledClaudeCodeVersion.description: The version of Claude Code the release bundles, which updates with the environment.

name.description: The asset's file name on the release: agent-harness-linux-x64.tar.gz.

kind.description: What an asset is: environment, desktop, install-script, compose, host-updater, schema (environment being the environment's self-contained artefact for one platform); a kind the reader does not know is a later release's, and is passed over.

anyOf.description: A platform, <os>-<arch> as Node names them: linux-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64; a later release may add others.

platform.description: The platform it is built for; null for one any platform takes, such as a script.

anyOf.description: How an asset is packed: tar.gz or zip for the environment's artefacts, zip (a macOS bundle), nsis (a Windows setup) or pacman (an Arch package) for the desktop's, as its shell reports the format it installs.

format.description: How it is packed; null for a plain file.

size.description: Its size in bytes, checked with its SHA-256 before it is unpacked.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

items.description: One asset of a release: its name, kind, platform, format, size and SHA-256.

assets.description: Every asset the release publishes but the manifest itself and the .sha256 sidecars.

reference.description: The image's reference, tagged with the exact version: git.systemtech.dev:5526/david/agent-harness:0.5.0.

digest.description: The image's digest, sha256: then 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits: a pull is checked against it.

image.description: The release's container image: its exact version reference and its digest.

description: The release manifest, release.json: the release's version, protocol version, launcher protocol, database schema version and bundled Claude Code version, its assets, and its container image.
